articles.title: SonicWall Warns of Potential In-the-Wild Exploitation of SSLVPN Flaw That Bypasses MFA
articles.summary:
SonicWall has warned customers to patch a SonicOS SSLVPN vulnerability that could let attackers bypass SAML authentication and its multi-factor authentication checks. Tracked as CVE-2026-19868, the flaw carries a CVSS score of 7.1. The company has investigated a report indicating potential exploitation and strongly urges customers to upgrade promptly.
